summary: Owned-set publications can carry a source map: `fractal apply --set ... --source-map FILE` records one source.mapped claim per new agent or mission revision with deduplicated file texts, readable at GET /v1/source-maps and GET /v1/source-blobs/{sha256}

replay.detail: No replay change; source.mapped claims are durable, system-written, and fold into no projection.

schema.detail: No SQL migration; new durable claim kind source.mapped on <agent|mission>/<id>@<revision>, whose files name their texts as claim-referenced blobs under blob_hash. The set apply result gains source_maps {recorded, kept, blobs_new, blobs_deduped}; the publication body limit grows by the 32 MiB map cap.

rules.detail: A map is validated before the noop return and refused (invalid-source-map, source-blob-missing) when it names a non-member, a malformed span or an unknown sha256; nothing is applied then. The first mapped publication of a revision wins and later maps are kept, never refused. Maps enter no revision, bundle, preview, set or idempotency digest.

compatibility.detail: Adding the claim kind changes the claim-registry digest; existing mismatched-registry guards apply until every member runs a build that recognizes source.mapped. Publications without --source-map are unchanged.

manual.detail: No action required; publishers opt in with --source-map.

recovery.detail: Mixed-version swap-back has not been exercised. Preserve source.mapped claims and their blobs and roll forward to a build that recognizes the kind if an older build cannot process it.
